bagPolicy.summary: Pechanga Arena San Diego enforces a clear bag policy allowing clear tote bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” and small clutches up to 4.5” x 6.5”. Oversized bags are prohibited.
allowed: Clear tote bags up to 12” x 6” x 12”
One-gallon clear plastic freezer or storage bags
Small clutch bags or wallets up to 4.5” x 6.5”
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Preferred Parking offers guaranteed closest to the door spaces, skip the line access, and priority exit. Parking fees vary by event and can be paid in advance or upon entry. Overnight parking is prohibited unless authorized.

rideshare.note: Enter from Sports Arena Boulevard for rideshare pickup and drop-off. Use the marked loading areas in front of the arena shown on the official entry map.

concessions.note: Pechanga Arena San Diego offers a variety of local food and beverage options, including Pizza Port and Nicolosi’s Italian Restaurant. Beverage highlights include Cutwater Tequila and Just Enough Wines, providing a diverse selection of drinks throughout the concourse.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: To buy accessible seats online, find your event on pechangaarenasd.com, click purchase tickets to go to AXS, then choose Accessible Tickets. You can also request them in person at the box office at 3500 Sports Arena Blvd. Always say you need accessible seating when ordering.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Pechanga Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will Call is located at the Box Office on the North side of Pechanga Arena San Diego. In Person – Visit the Pechanga Arena San Diego Box Office located at 3500 Sports Arena Blvd, San Diego, CA 92110 and request accessible tickets.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Metal detectors are used at all entrances for every event, so plan to arrive at least one hour before the scheduled start time. If you bring a prohibited item, you'll be asked to return it to your vehicle, and items left at an entrance are thrown away.
